title: Doozy Vape Co Infinity Pineapple Raspberry Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml
description: Pineapple Raspberry by Doozy Infinity is a bright, juicy fruit combo that balances sweet and tangy notes with delightful results. The Pineapple comes through with its sharp and tangy, golden sweetness, while Raspberry adds a ruby red jammy depth that’s both vibrant and slightly tart. Together, they create a refreshing all-day vape that delivers deep flavour and reliable satisfaction. This 70VG/30PG high-VG e-liquid is designed for Sub-Ohm vaping and performs best in powerful DTL (direct-to-lung) devices and vape tanks. Each 120ml shortfill bottle contains 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, with room to add two 10ml nicotine shots to suit your preference. Part of the Doozy Infinity Shortfill range, this fruity blend delivers the fuller flavour and thicker clouds Sub-Ohm vapers expect.
